decisions.reason: The source explicitly sets a small black Zebra border, but that change is already fully represented by the candidate's message-32 MODIFY. The approval does not select one of the three presented Zebra directions or necessarily establish an additional palette update.
Proceeding to final artwork and requesting borders does not change the production-ready, CMYK, or seamless-repeat file-format requirements.
The statement about moving to the block-print stage afterward is a sequencing statement and does not change the Terracotta block-colour pareo's design, colour, border, or scope.
The source does not modify the Mustard block-colour pareo; the mustard border applies specifically to the Weave design, while the block-print reference only indicates a later work stage.
The client asks whether the freelancer is comfortable using the chosen Pantone colours but does not establish a new calibration method or replace the existing Pantone and ICC-profile plan.
